links.label: Nagafen bridge — lower before crossing
links.note: At the mapped bridge interaction, lower the bridge before crossing toward the lever side and Nagafen. Proceed only when a continuous crossing is present; stop if the bridge cannot be operated or the way is blocked. Endpoints follow the local Brewall bridge/lever annotations and project to separate dry floors. The line is a schematic connection, not a verified walking surface. Operation, bridge alignment, timing and passage in this direction require an in-game check.

links.label: Nagafen bridge — lower before crossing
links.note: From the mapped Bridge Lever side, lower the bridge before crossing toward the entrance side. Proceed only when a continuous crossing is present; stop if the bridge cannot be operated or the way is blocked. Endpoints follow the local Brewall bridge/lever annotations and project to separate dry floors. The line is a schematic connection, not a verified walking surface. Operation, bridge alignment, timing and passage in this direction require an in-game check.
